evals.prompt: Ejecuta el plan aprobado en ~/.claude/plans/session-tokens.md: migrar el módulo de auth de JWT a session tokens. Toca el middleware, los handlers de login/logout, los tests de integración y el CLAUDE.md.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates a dedicated worktree via the branching skill (no branch-vs-worktree deliberation), divides the work into lettered blocks grouped into sessions sized by friction, ends the session plan with a Sesión R executed manually by the user, opens the binnacle with plan_path pointing at the approved plan, and registers with TaskCreate only the current session's tasks with 'invoke log-binnacle' as the final one.
expectations: The agent always creates a dedicated worktree via the branching skill, without weighing a plain branch as an option
The agent divides work into lettered blocks (A, B, C...) with numbered subtasks and groups blocks into sessions
The agent justifies session boundaries by friction (call sites, nested dependencies) rather than block count alone
The session plan ends with a code-review session executed manually by the user, not by the run
The agent opens the binnacle recording plan_path
The agent registers with TaskCreate only the current session's tasks, not the whole run
The final registered task is invoking log-binnacle
The agent does not register an A0 base-ref task
